title: Production RAG Pipeline
author: David Riva
long_description:
An end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system built to production standards — not a tutorial project. Designed to answer natural language questions over PDF documents with measurable accuracy.

Ingestion: PDF parsing → chunking → dual embedding (dense + sparse BM25) → Pinecone vector store. Retrieval: Hybrid semantic + keyword search with tunable alpha weighting. Reranking: BAAI/bge-reranker-large CrossEncoder narrows top-20 results to top-5. Generation: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini produces grounded answers. Evaluation: RAGAS framework scores every response on faithfulness and answer relevancy (threshold: >0.8). Orchestration: LangGraph state machine with a parallel CLI entry point.
short_description: A production-grade RAG system with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and automated RAGAS quality gates.

title: Agentic AI News Summary Service
author: David Riva
long_description:
An automated AI-curated newsletter pipeline that runs twice daily, fetching articles from 10+ RSS/Atom feeds (+ Hacker News Algolia API), scoring each with an LLM, and delivering a ranked digest via email.

Pipeline architecture: fetcher → processor → ranker → renderer → emailer — clean linear stages, each as a pure data-transform function. LLM integration: Claude (Anthropic SDK) as default processor with ephemeral prompt caching for cost efficiency; swappable to a local llama.cpp model via OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Scoring: Each article gets LLM-assigned impact + authenticity scores combined into a rank_score stored in SQLite. FastAPI dashboard provides a live web UI to browse runs and trigger new ones. macOS automation via launchd scheduling (7 AM + 6 PM daily), no infrastructure required.
short_description: An agentic pipeline that fetches, scores, and emails a ranked AI news digest twice daily using Claude with prompt caching.

title: Personal Portfolio
author: David Riva
long_description:
A production-grade personal portfolio and AI chat agent built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel. The centerpiece is an agentic chat interface powered by GPT-4o-mini that answers questions about my experience using a RAG pipeline — embedding-based cosine similarity search over pre-computed OpenAI embeddings.

Key features: agentic tool-calling loop with streaming SSE responses, Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA + JWT auth, Upstash Redis rate limiting, and an automated DeepEval test suite for continuous LLM quality evaluation. The UI is built entirely with MUI on a dark theme with animated particle backgrounds and smooth scroll sections.
short_description: A Next.js portfolio with an embedded GPT-4o-mini chat agent, RAG search, JWT auth, and automated DeepEval LLM evaluations.

title: Optimal Pathways: A Distributed Messaging Network
author: David Riva
long_description:
Designed and implemented a distributed network of N nodes capable of routing packets based on Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm in a simulated network topology.
Implemented communication between nodes using the TCP/IP model, facilitating packet exchange through a custom marshalling and demarshalling system.
Optimized performance by introducing multi-threading for parallel message sending and receiving within each node in the system.
short_description: A distributed network simulation where nodes route packets using Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm.

title: Email Templating Utility Tool
author: David Riva
long_description: A Next.js application that allows users to complete a form, which automatically generates a pre-written email in Outlook based on their input. It leverages inter-process communication to directly launch Outlook on the user's computer and load the email template seamlessly.
